summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US filed an 8-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 First Amendment to its April 24, 2026 Confidential Settlement and Mutual Release Agreement with MindWave Innovations, FreeT Inc., Apimeds Inc. and Erik Emerson, restructuring board composition. The interim board is fixed at four named directors removable only with consent of Dr. Vin Menon and the Inscobee Parties; post-Preferred Stock Conversion the board expands to seven: four MindWave-nominated independents, two Menon nominees (including Menon), and Sungjoon Chae. Chae was appointed immediately. No price, stake, or premium terms were stated. Watch for the conversion trigger and any further consent-right disputes.
